summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured PAM limits (nofile 8192, nproc 256 soft/hard) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified effective via a login shell. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot id and healthy state, issued a native reboot, confirmed the boot id changed after reconnecting, and re-verified account, config file, and effective limits post-restart.
actions_performed: Created user 'appworker' with useradd -m on node1
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf setting nofile soft/hard=8192 and nproc soft/hard=256
Verified via 'su - appworker' login shell that ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state (account + limits config + effective ulimits)
Issued 'shutdown -r now' via sudo -n as a backgrounded ack-then-disconnect command
Polled node1 until SSH/exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed from e9250ad1-c4f0-4bec-b58e-4e30255a8dcf to 88f7d64a-ed72-4407-a6fe-49bb7d5a4d81, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified appworker account, limits.d config, and effective login-shell ulimits post-restart

evidence.summary: useradd -m appworker succeeded; id shows uid=1001(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf sets soft/hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256; verified live via 'su - appworker' showing ulimit -n=8192, ulimit -u=256 (both soft and hard)
Captured boot_id e9250ad1... plus direct proof account and limits were healthy before restart
sudo -n shutdown -r now issued in background; command returned ack (connection closed by remote host) before node went unreachable

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot (timeout), then reachable again with boot_id changed to 88f7d64a-ed72-4407-a6fe-49bb7d5a4d81

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required state
evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account, limits.d config file, and effective login-shell ulimits (8192 files / 256 processes) all verified intact
